```{r}
#| include: false
# Data comes from firm_roles_to_csv.R. Re-render after re-running it.
roles <- read.csv("smf_roles.csv", colClasses = "character", encoding = "UTF-8")
roles <- roles[startsWith(roles$smf_role, "SMF"), ]

# Order roles SMF1, SMF2, ..., SMF20, SMF20a by number, then letter suffix.
role_num <- as.integer(sub("^SMF(\\d+).*", "\\1", roles$smf_role))
role_suffix <- sub("^SMF\\d+([a-z]*).*", "\\1", roles$smf_role)
roles$role_rank <- match(
  roles$smf_role,
  unique(roles$smf_role[order(role_num, role_suffix, roles$smf_role)])
)
roles <- roles[order(tolower(roles$firm_name), roles$role_rank, roles$name), ]
ojs_define(roles_raw = roles)

# The download button serves the file exactly as on disk, not the filtered view.
csv_text <- readChar("smf_roles.csv", file.size("smf_roles.csv"), useBytes = TRUE)
Encoding(csv_text) <- "UTF-8"
ojs_define(roles_csv = csv_text)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
data = transpose(roles_raw)
uniq = (xs) => Array.from(new Set(xs)).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))

// Role choices follow the firm filter, so only roles that exist show.
byFirm = data.filter(d => firm === "All firms" || d.firm_name === firm)
roleChoices = {
  const rank = new Map(byFirm.map(d => [d.smf_role, d.role_rank]));
  return [...rank.keys()].sort((a, b) => rank.get(a) - rank.get(b));
}

filtered = {
  const q = person.trim().toLowerCase();
  return byFirm.filter(d =>
    (role === "All roles" || d.smf_role === role) &&
    (q === "" ||
      d.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.individual_ref.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.individual_id.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  );
}
```

# {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof firm = Inputs.select(["All firms", ...uniq(data.map(d => d.firm_name))], {
  label: "Firm"
})
viewof role = Inputs.select(["All roles", ...roleChoices], {label: "Role"})
viewof person = Inputs.text({
  label: "Individual",
  placeholder: "Name, reference or id"
})
```

```{ojs}
DOM.download(
  () => new Blob([roles_csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"}),
  "smf_roles.csv",
  "Download full CSV"
)
```

Downloads every row of `smf_roles.csv`, ignoring the filters above.

Data: [FCA Financial Services Register](https://register.fca.org.uk/s/), individuals currently involved with each firm.

```{ojs}
stat = (label, value) => htl.html`<div style="flex:1; padding:0.6rem 1rem; border-radius:6px; background:#eef3f8">
  <div style="font-size:0.85rem; color:#4a5a6a">${label}</div>
  <div style="font-size:1.8rem; font-weight:600; color:#1f3b57">${value.toLocaleString()}</div>
</div>`

htl.html`<div style="display:flex; gap:1rem; height:100%; align-items:stretch">
  ${stat("SMF roles", filtered.length)}
  ${stat("Individuals", new Set(filtered.map(d => d.individual_id)).size)}
  ${stat("Firms", new Set(filtered.map(d => d.frn)).size)}
</div>`
```
